title: finding(fields): `BooleanField`'s readonly branch reads the value by truthiness — the string `'false'` and `{}` say "Yes"
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8582, which ruled — on `@objectstack/spec`'s value contract — that only a real boolean is a value of a boolean column and moved `BooleanCellRenderer` off truthiness. This card records the same reading one surface over: the read-only branch of the edit widget. DOM shapes are written in words; tag-shaped fragments are eaten from GitHub bodies even inside backticks.

## Measured

`packages/fields/src/widgets/BooleanField.tsx` on `21529629c` (origin/main), line 54: the `if (readonly)` branch returns a small-text span whose text is `value ? 'Yes' : 'No'`.

The widget is registered for `boolean` and `toggle` in `FieldEditWidget.tsx`, and its props are typed `FieldWidgetComponentProps` of `boolean`, but the runtime value is whatever the record holds. Read by truthiness:

| stored value | readonly widget says |
|---|---|
| the string `'false'` | **Yes** |
| the string `'0'` | **Yes** |
| `{}` | **Yes** |
| `[]` | **Yes** |
| `0`, `''` | No |

The first four are the objectui#8582 / objectui#8490 class of defect — an affirmative statement the record never made — reached through the form's read-only rendering instead of the grid cell. The edit branch coerces the same way (`checked={!!value}` on the Checkbox / Switch) but at least writes a real boolean back through `onChange(!!checked)`; the readonly branch only asserts.

## The ruling already exists

objectui#8582 established, on four spec instruments, that the renderer owns no truth table: `valueSchemaFor` returns a bare `z.boolean()` for `boolean` / `toggle`; `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` is "a JS boolean on the wire (driver read-coercion repairs SQL 0/1)"; `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES` says the stored value is "never text on any backend"; and the `'true'` / `1` / `'0'` truth table lives at the producer boundaries (objectql's `coerceBooleanFields` and `invalid_boolean` refusal, `rest`'s `parseBooleanCell`). The same guard applies here: a non-boolean in read-only mode renders the shared `EmptyValue` affordance; a real `false` still says **No**.

Not fenced by objectui#8582's PR: that card names `BooleanCellRenderer` only, and this widget has its own test surface (`standard-widgets.test.tsx`).

## Dedup

Repo-scoped REST is 403 from this container (proxy allowlist), so one targeted MCP `search_issues` was used — declared channel switch. It returned objectui#8582 (the cell-renderer card) and the closed objectui#3952 (the widget's dangling label `for`), neither of which is this defect; a non-empty result needs no control.

Filed unassigned, not claimed, by the ObjectUI dev agent working objectui#8582, session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`, from branch `claude/issue-8582-boolean-cell-non-boolean-scalars`. (Attribution written as prose deliberately: a footer block is stripped from issue bodies on create.)
